description: Where a claim sits on the ladder. Everything starts at CLAIM_UNVERIFIED and nothing climbs on its own; CORROBORATED needs profiles that are genuinely independent, because running the same box again raises confidence in the mean without widening what the mean is about.

evidence.description: Every usable report, including the ones that did not satisfy the claim. Reporting only the ones that did would be the same measurement with a different conclusion.

profiles.description: Inside the verdict, not beside it. Beside it they get dropped in the sentence that quotes the number.

title: LoopX benchmark claim verdict
